wizard.title: Getting started
wizard.backToLatest: Go back to where you stopped

1.title: About you
1.description: Your identity as written in your passport.

2.title: Study language
2.description: The language you will study in, and your current level.

3.title: Your studies so far
3.description: Baccalaureate and any university degrees you already hold.

4.title: Where do you want to live?
4.description: Choose the Italian city you are interested in.

5.title: University and program
5.description: Pick the program you want to apply to. You can add more later.

6.title: Scholarship
6.description: Tell us if you plan to apply for a scholarship.

7.title: How will your studies be funded?
7.description: List every source of funding. Add one at a time.

8.title: Your sponsors
8.description: Who is the person behind each family sponsor source?

9.title: Your sponsors' situation
9.description: The documents we ask for depend on each sponsor's professional situation.

10.title: Your personalized checklist
10.description: Built from your situation and the current requirements.

f.passportHint: We check that it stays valid long enough for your visa.
f.studyLanguage: In which language will you study?
f.languageLevelHint: In the language of your program
f.certificateHint: For example CILS, CELI, IELTS, TOEFL
f.declarationHint: Status of your Declaration of Value
f.desiredDegreeLevel: Degree level you want to study
f.noMatchingPrograms: We found no program matching your city, degree level and language. Here are all available programs.
f.programNote: Choosing a program does not guarantee admission. You can add other applications later.
f.wantsScholarship: Do you plan to apply for a scholarship?
f.noScholarships: No scholarship is listed for this academic year yet. Our team will help you.
f.tndHint: Funds in TND count toward the euro requirement only once our team enters the euro value.
f.fundingNote: Add every source: family sponsors, scholarships, institutional funding or other funds.
f.noSponsorNeeded: You have not added any family sponsor, so there is nothing to fill in here.
f.relationshipHint: The Embassy accepts relatives up to the 4th degree.
f.pensionFundHint: We do not assume it: please choose.
f.unemployedNote: A sponsor without income cannot fund your studies. Tell us who does and where the money comes from.
f.otherNote: Our team will check this situation with you before we prepare the documents.

checklist.intro: We will build your list of documents from everything you told us.
checklist.reviewTitle: Our team will check part of your file
checklist.reviewBody: Some information needs a human check before we can tell you exactly which documents you need. We will contact you.
checklist.basedOn: Based on current Italian Embassy requirements. The Embassy may ask for additional documents or an interview.
